title: Robert Towns Monument, Castle Hill
visualBrief: Complete Castle Hill Robert Towns Monument: two own octagonal stepped plinths, white chamfered Gothic tablet pedestal/four gables/trefoil relief/scroll shoulders, grey tapered octagonal shaft/medallion and toothed bands, and foliate broken capital. Exact named native point and actual southern access retained; all monument dimensions/facing photo-estimated. No natural hill or lookout grounds.
